entries.failure_mode: MG↔Astro difficult to distinguish on evidence surface (macroglia granularity wall), dictionary misleading readings have precedent
entries.observable_signature: High-frequency mutual labeling between macroglia two classes; exacerbated in DR reactive gliosis (GFAP↑) scenarios
entries.mitigation: Mutual labeling of macroglia two classes must carry 'granularity wall' annotation; MG entry prohibits ambiguous co-expressed genes like GLUL/VIM/CLU (KB7 revision done); Astro/MG determination upgraded to manual re-review item in DR reactive gliosis (GFAP↑) scenarios.

provenance.home_rationale: Wall itself holds across tissues (retina/optic nerve macroglia), evidence surface is human → pattern tagged with dual tissue
